**Root cause:** the model had `"MultiRowSelect": true` sitting alongside `"execution_mode": "edit"` and `"columnEditing": true`. Per the platform's General Process spec, `MultiRowSelect` is the legacy flag for `execution_mode: "select"` (checkbox-driven row selection) — it should never be set together with `"edit"` mode. Comparing against its working sibling `fam_gen_dep_companies_act` (same "edit" mode, same workflow) confirmed that one has neither flag at all — only `columnEditing: true`. The stray `MultiRowSelect: true` on this object made the frontend send a request shape the backend didn't expect, which is consistent with a 422 (Unprocessable Entity) right at Generate.

**Change made:** removed the erroneous `"MultiRowSelect": true` line from `Metadata_Model/general_process_models/model_fam_gen_dep_income_tax.json`, keeping `"columnEditing": true"` (which correctly matches `execution_mode: "edit"`). Verified the file is still valid JSON. No other files touched — this restores the documented Generate → review/edit → Approve & Post workflow already in the FRS, so no FRS update was needed.

Please retry "Generate" on this screen — it should go through now. If it still 422s, let me know and I'll dig into the actual request payload next.
